_comment: Points on a route that matter for their own sake rather than as somewhere to stop. HAND-MAINTAINED - no script writes here. prepare_gpx.py strips every type=Milestone waypoint and rewrites them from this file on each run, so entries are idempotent and a hand-edited GPX is never the record. Coordinates should sit ON the track: a milestone is a course point the head unit shows as you reach it, not a destination. 'sym' is a Garmin symbol name. Day 4's are the SAG rendezvous plan; day 8's is the finish line.

8.name: FINISH LINE — Santa Monica Pier
8.note: The end of the ride. The track carries on 0.34 mi to the hotel.
